reference.question: Calculate \(90^\circ-38^\circ27′\) and write the result in the form \(a^\circ b′\). Enter a and b in that order, separated by a comma.
reference.solution:
Method 1: Regroup one degree

Write \(90^\circ\) as \(89^\circ60′\). Then \(89^\circ60′-38^\circ27′=51^\circ33′\).
